name: Order Picking App
author: Arture B.V.

sections.description:
Faster, smarter, error-free order picking for WooCommerce with real-time guidance, barcode scanning, and scalable workflows.

Orderpicking App helps warehouses, fulfillment centers, and ecommerce businesses streamline their picking process and eliminate costly errors.
Our mission is efficient picking for everyone — from small webshops to high-volume operations.

Orderpicking App gives you everything you need to manage order picking accurately, efficiently, and at scale.
Premium features unlock deeper insights, smart automation, and powerful integrations to take your operations even further — with no hidden fees.

Giving you the operational edge

Order picking is one of the most time-consuming and error-prone processes in logistics — but it doesn’t have to be.
Whether you’re digitizing your first picking process or optimizing a mature warehouse operation, Orderpicking App helps your team pick faster, smarter, and with confidence.

Keeping Orderpicking App up to date means you automatically benefit from continuous performance improvements, UX refinements, and new automation features — all built around real warehouse workflows.
Empower your pickers with clear instructions, real-time validation, and intuitive mobile interfaces that reduce mistakes and boost productivity from day one.

Quick and easy setup

Getting started with Orderpicking App is fast and straightforward — no technical background required.

Our guided setup helps you:

  • Download the Orderpicking App plugin
  • Create a free 30-day trial
  • Install the app on your phone or tablet (iOS and Android)
  • Scan the API barcode with your device
  • Configure your settings — and start picking immediately

Switching from paper picking, spreadsheets, or another system?
Migration is simple. Import your orders and settings safely and start picking right away.

Core picking features

Unlock the full potential of your warehouse with powerful, easy-to-use picking tools.

Picking & workflow

  • Real-time order picking on mobile devices
  • Barcode scanning for product, bin, and order validation
  • Single and batch picking support
  • Clear pick instructions per item and location
  • Visual and audio feedback to prevent picking errors
  • Automatic order status updates

Productivity & quality

  • Fewer errors through scan validation
  • Faster onboarding for new pickers
  • Consistent workflows across teams and shifts
  • Reduced returns caused by picking mistakes
  • Unlimited pickers
  • Picklist overview to identify low-stock items before fulfillment issues occur

Automation and smart features

Orderpicking App removes manual steps so your team can focus on speed and accuracy.

Smart features include:
* Automatic pick confirmation
* Intelligent item sorting and prioritization
* Configurable picking settings per warehouse or client
* Real-time synchronization between devices
* Optimized picking routes by category, location, or custom fields
* Narrowcasting dashboard with real-time status updates
* Smart analytics to track picker performance and results

These tools help you scale operations without adding complexity.

Demo Video

See Orderpicking App in action:

This video walks through the mobile workflows, setup, and how picking works in practice — perfect for new users and evaluators.

Performance and reliability

Orderpicking App is built for real-world webshop and warehouse conditions.
* Fast and responsive, even with large order volumes
* Optimized for mobile cameras, Bluetooth scanners, and Zebra scanners
* Stable performance during peak periods such as Black Friday, Christmas, and holidays
* Secure data handling with role-based access, picker passcodes, and configurable working hours

Every update delivers performance improvements and operational enhancements automatically.

Keep your picking under control

Whether you’re a warehouse manager, operations lead, or business owner, Orderpicking App helps you stay in control:
* Real-time visibility into picking progress
* Clear order status updates
* Reduced dependency on paper and manual checks
* Consistent execution across teams and locations

Integrations and flexibility

Orderpicking App fits seamlessly into your existing stack:
* Works with WooCommerce and other popular ecommerce platforms
* API access for custom integrations
* Flexible configuration for different warehouse layouts
* Designed to grow with your operation

Need something specific?
The platform is built to adapt — and our support team is fast, helpful, and genuinely committed to solving your challenges.

Built for teams

Orderpicking App is designed for real warehouse teams:
* Simple, intuitive interface for pickers
* Powerful controls for managers
* Minimal training required
* Works smoothly across shifts and roles

Ongoing improvement and support

Orderpicking App is continuously improved by a team that understands warehouse operations.
We’re committed to helping teams work better with:
* Regular feature updates
* Ongoing performance improvements
* Customer-driven enhancements
* Fast, reliable ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ support

Orderpicking App — built to make order picking faster, more accurate, and ready to scale.
sections.installation:
Getting started with Orderpicking App is quick and easy:

  1. Install and activate the Orderpicking App plugin.
  2. Start your free 30-day trial directly inside WooCommerce.
  3. Download the Orderpicking App on your iOS or Android device.
  4. Scan the API barcode (or enter the API key manually).
  5. Configure your settings to match your workflow.
  6. You’re ready to start picking orders 🚀
sections.faq:
How do I connect the Orderpicking App to my WooCommerce store?

Install and activate the Orderpicking App plugin from the WordPress plugin directory. Then log in to your Orderpicking App account, copy the API key, and paste it into the plugin settings in your WordPress dashboard. The app will sync orders automatically.

Can I try the Orderpicking App before I pay?

Yes — you can start a free 30-day trial directly inside WooCommerce after installing the plugin, with no commitments.

Which devices work with the Orderpicking App?

Orderpicking App supports iOS and Android devices. You can use smartphones, tablets, or (Bluetooth) PDA scanners for mobile picking

Do orders sync automatically from WooCommerce?

Yes — once connected, orders in WooCommerce are pulled into the Orderpicking App automatically, with no manual export required.

How do I switch between single and batch picking?

You can configure picking type (single or batch) in the plugin or portal settings. Batch picking allows grouping multiple orders in one run to reduce walking time.

What WooCommerce order status does the app use?

The plugin default imports orders when they enter the “Processing” status in WooCommerce, making them available for picking. We also have settings to select custom statuses for picking.
